results.content:
While the game is similar to others in the sub-genre, it does enough new things to earn its place at the table. The only real negative for the game is the UI/UX design. It feels clunky and there are too many needless clicks that slow everything down for the player. My biggest complaint is that the game keeps running while you are in menus. For a game based on logic, planning, and reason, this breaks the formula. The game is fun and rewarding though. The series has a bright future and I am happy to continue small purchases to support the development. Thank you, Dev!
